title: Equivariant generating hypotheses for finite groups
summary: We prove that no nontrivial finite group $G$ satisfies the equivariant generating hypothesis of Bohmann, even when all $RO(H)$-graded homotopy groups are tested for every subgroup $H\leq G$. For each $G$, we construct ghosts on finite $G$-spectra with arbitrarily long nonzero composition powers. We also prove that the homotopy-module functors are nonfull and construct non-equivalent finite $G$-spectra with isomorphic full homotopy modules.
